product_overview: A Streamlit-based sales data dashboard that lets users explore sales by region and product and save named filter presets for quick reuse.
core_goals: Open and explore the sales dashboard with the default dataset to review charts and tables
Filter sales data by region and product to focus analysis on subsets of interest
Save the current region/product filter configuration as a named preset for later reuse

features.name: Dashboard - View Sales Data
features.description: Load the main dashboard and interactively explore the default sales dataset with filters and visualizations.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See dashboard loaded with the default sales dataset -> Select region(s) to narrow the dataset -> Select product(s) to narrow the dataset -> Observe charts and tables update to reflect selected filters

features.name: Create Custom Filters
features.description: Save the current combination of region and product selections as a named configuration preset so the same filtered view can be reused later.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select region(s) -> Select product(s) -> Enter a name for the current configuration -> Save the current configuration -> See success message "Configuración '<name>' guardada."

routes.description: Main dashboard for sales data analysis

features.description: Save current region and product filter configurations as a custom named preset
user_interactions: Type name into "Nombre de la configuración actual" text input
